name: io.github.flashdata-dev/google-places
title: Google Places — FlashData
description: Google Places businesses, addresses, ratings and review counts. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with google_places access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Shortlist local businesses by rating and review count
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0].places. Keep entries with rating at least 4.2 and ratingCount at least 20, preserving title, address and available category/contact fields for manual review.
dev.flashdata.limits: Ratings and contact information can be absent. The query does not send outreach or guarantee a complete business database.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
